How renting works

Four steps, no runaround. Most folks are hooked up and rolling in about fifteen minutes.

1

Book or call

Send a booking request from this page, or reach Samantha at (678) 532-0850. She'll confirm availability and lock in your dates.

2

Pick up in Oxford

Come to 1107 Cook Rd, Oxford GA. Bring your driver's license and a vehicle with a hitch — we'll help you hook up and check the lights.

3

Haul what you need

The 6×12's ramp gate makes loading mowers, ATVs, and furniture easy. Keep loads under the 2,145 lb payload and strap everything down.

4

Bring it back

Return it to the same spot by the end of your last rental day. Need more time? Call before it's due and extend at the same daily rate.

Also on Towlos & Marketplace

The 6×12 is also listed on Towlos and Facebook Marketplace if you'd rather book there. Heads-up on deposits: booking direct or through Marketplace is no-deposit — Towlos holds a $150 deposit on their bookings (their platform minimum).

Questions

The ones everybody asks. Anything else — call or text Samantha at (678) 532-0850.

What trailers and equipment do you rent?
Right now the fleet is our 2026 Max Built 6×12 utility trailer at $80/day. More equipment is on the way — a car hauler, a dump trailer, and an enclosed cargo trailer are planned next. The fleet section above always shows what's available now and what's coming.
How does booking online work?
Pick your equipment and dates in the booking form and hit submit — it opens a ready-to-send email with everything filled in (there's a text option too). Samantha confirms availability by phone or text before anything is final. No payment is taken online; you pay at pickup.
How much is it, really?
The 6×12 is $80 per day, flat — same price on weekdays and weekends. Book direct, through this site, or through Facebook Marketplace and there's no deposit. Towlos bookings carry a $150 deposit because that's the platform's minimum; it's held by Towlos, not us.
What can I haul on the 6×12?
The deck is 6×12 ft and rated for about 2,145 lbs of payload (2,995 lb GVWR minus the 850 lb trailer). Mowers, ATVs, side-by-sides, furniture, appliances, lumber, and yard debris are all right in its wheelhouse. When in doubt, ask Samantha when you book.
What do I need to rent?
A valid driver's license, a tow vehicle with a hitch, and a way to pay the rental at pickup. We'll walk through hookup and light checks with you before you leave.
Do you deliver?
No — pickup and return are at 1107 Cook Rd, Oxford, GA 30054. It's a quick trip from Covington, Conyers, Monroe, and Loganville.
Can I keep it longer than planned?
Usually, yes — just call or text before your return time. Extra days are the same daily rate, as long as the equipment isn't already promised to the next renter.
Who runs White Compass?
White Compass LLC is a Georgia company based in Oxford, formed in 2025. Samantha Sumner handles the rentals — she's the one who answers (678) 532-0850.
